original_target.title: Polynomial-time DNF learning from uniform random examples
original_target.area: Statistical learning, Boolean rules and computational complexity

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original classical noiseless examples-only uniform PAC learning of every s-term DNF in time polynomial n,s,1/epsilon,log1/delta with efficient improper hypothesis allowed. Alman et al Theorem1 uses membership queries and returns a candidate-term list, not a full hypothesis; the learning theorem is quasipolynomial and assumes exact equal-length terms. Quantum and pairwise/numerical queries exceed the allowed access. The we-solve distribution-free page explicitly remains Open; its visible conditional consistency-to-learning argument is not a supplied polynomial consistency algorithm. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
